Title: Online Marketing Manager
Job Description:
Vinnayana (formerly Pratik Renuse BV) is a Dutch consulting company based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, helping startups scale their business to 7 figures. Having worked with leading corporations like Airbus, Google, Bayer and thereafter helping build startups to 7 figures (>$1 million), we now aim to help startups succeed.


We have an active portfolio of over 7 companies from USA, Europe and Asia, and you would be involved in their marketing operations.


We would love to hear from you if you -


- are entrepreneurial and bring a founder mindset.

- are ambitious, self motivated and want to invest in building a great career.

- care more about what you learn and the impact that you make.

- take ownership of all your tasks and execute independently.

- believe in work-life integration. passion > balance.



What we value and how we work

  • when in doubt, let first principles guide you. ask yourself, will this help our mission? if the answer is yes, it will be the right road to take.
  • innovation is our best friend and getting attached to a process, our worst enemy. everything that we do today can be improved.
  • don't take your ideas too seriously. test everything. move on quickly.
  • feedback moves things forward and helps you grow. don't get offended or take it personally. when giving feedback, focus on the 'delta'. the 20% that can change the 80%.
  • quality with speed > perfection.
  • practice predicting 2nd and 3rd order effects of your decisions.
  • don't confuse process with progress.
  • prioritize ruthlessly.


Once you join us, you are not only paid salary but share of profits too month over month! We believe in long term commitment towards growing together.



Your role:

Managing the daily marketing operations for clients

Lead asset creation, targeting, and campaign analysis 

Explore and execute new paid marketing channels

Optimise conversion rates across websites

Setting up and taking responsibility for the KPIs with clients


Qualifications:


  • Background in turning marketing campaign results into business results in a ROI-positive way
  • Demonstrated history to manage multiple projects and hit deadlines
  • Experience planning and producing marketing campaigns
  • Proven marketing experience.
Company Industries: Venture Capital and Private Equity Principals
